Royal Enfield Launches Himalayan 440 Motorcycle in India

Royal Enfield has launched the Himalayan 440 motorcycle in India. The vehicle features a 440cc engine and a 6-speed gearbox. It is equipped with an advanced Tripper navigation system. The motorcycle is positioned as an off-road vehicle.
